CVE-2025-27234.conditions: own live container zlab_agent2_5; raw 5.0 passive protocol (ZBXD\x01+LE64 raw item key); smart.disk.get[device,mode]
CVE-2025-27234.note: RCE-флейвор НЕ воспроизведён: параметры проходят cleanRegex ^[a-zA-Z0-9 \-_/\\\\.]*$ (clearString, добавлен в 5.0.40, DEV-2701) — все shell-метасимволы (;,|,&,$(),backticks,кавычки,\n) отклоняются с ZBX_NOTSUPPORTED 'Invalid characters found in parameter'. Флаг-инъекция в argv smartctl работает (-V долетает, smartctl версия в выводе).

CVE-2025-27234.conditions: own live container zlab_agent2; JSON passive checks protocol
CVE-2025-27234.note: Санитизации НЕТ (параметры verbatim), но вызов через exec-массив (exec.CommandContext('sudo','-n',smartctl,args...), controller.go) — шелла нет, argv-only: флаги (-V, -f, -l scttempsts) доходят до smartctl, исполнения команд нет.

smart.disk.get device/mode -> shell-backed smartctl -> инъекция ';cmd;' исполняется от zabbix (touch-маркеры /tmp/pwn30* созданы). Полный ИНТЕРАКТИВНЫЙ ШЕЛЛ через fifo+nc payload: 'sh: can't access tty; job control turned off; /var/lib/zabbix $ id -> uid=1997(zabbix)'. RCE-флейвор 5.0 подтверждён live.

Модуль: --cmd/--shell подтверждены live. Payload обёрнут в (setsid sh -c '<fifo+nc chain>' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &) — переживает плагинный kill (~3s 'Timeout while executing a shell script'): --cmd вернул uid=1997(zabbix) + hostname c54cae9b6230, --shell исполнил id и hostname построчно, exit закрыл сессию. Без setsid старый foreground-вариант отдавал только баннер (sh умирал до прихода команды) — фикс обязателен.

CVE-2024-22120.conditions: default creds Admin/zabbix; trapper 10051 (mapped); PostgreSQL backend
CVE-2024-22120.note: Blind time-based SQLi via trapper audit clientip verified live E2E -> RCE. Dual-time hex oracle (match: pg_sleep(2) else pg_sleep(0.6), ASCII equality, hex alphabet 0123456789abcdef), cross-checked against W01fh4cker/CVE-2024-22120-RCE and reporter PoC (support#236280) — identical. Extracted config.session_key (pos-1 byte flaked '1' vs 'd'; rest byte-exact to DB) and a real Super Admin sessionid 82ca9c81fb29777ef87471448281aac2 (verified in sessions, userid=1, status=0). script.create (super-admin only) accepted; script.execute returned uid=1997(zabbix) gid=1995(zabbix) on the 6.0.27 server. Full chain trapper SQLi -> admin session -> script RCE proven live. Cookie-forge mechanics (HMAC-SHA256(session_key, compact json)) validated separately; not required for the API-session RCE.

CVE-2025-27240.conditions: Admin creds; autoregistration action with 'Remove host' operation; host visible name = SQL payload; trapper trigger (active checks, changed host_metadata)
CVE-2025-27240.note: Secondary-order SQLi live on zlab_7_0_0 (web 47467, trapper 44646, PG). Error: server log '[Z3005] ... invalid input syntax for type integer: "ZBX27240" LINE 1: delete from autoreg_host where host='zpx'||CAST('ZBX27240' AS int)||'x''. Time-based: pg_stat_activity showed the escalator session active on 'delete from autoreg_host where host='zpx'||(SELECT pg_sleep(12))||'x'' for the full sleep. Module Cve202527240 (misc.py) ok=True: --sleep 8 -> trigger answered 13.02s (5s baseline + 8s), host removed. vuln code: op_host_del() sprintf's select_discovered_host() h.name into DBexecute('delete from autoreg_host where host='%s'') unescaped; fix 6416019f3117 [DEV-3902] added DBdyn_escape_string (6.0.34/6.4.19/7.0.4).

CVE-2025-27240.conditions: Admin creds; autoreg action 'Remove host'; visible name payload; trapper trigger after ~70s config-cache wait (CacheUpdateFrequency=60)
CVE-2025-27240.note: Live on zlab_6_0_27 (web 45495, trapper 44645, PG): server log '[Z3005] ... invalid input syntax for type integer: "ZBX27604B" [delete from autoreg_host where host='zpx'||CAST('ZBX27604B' AS int)||'x']'. Escalation async on 6.0; host-removal step (DBlock_hostids FOR UPDATE) can be skipped under DB load but the injected DELETE still executes — log/error evidence is the reliable channel, latency oracle is not (unlike 7.0.0). Same vulnerable code path as the fix diff.
